name: 事务隔离与 MVCC 诊断
description: PostgreSQL 使用 MVCC（多版本并发控制）实现事务隔离，支持 Read Committed（默认）、Repeatable Read、Serializable 三个级别。常见问题：长事务/idle in transaction 阻止 VACUUM 回收、Serializable 的 SSI 序列化失败需应用重试、两阶段提交的 prepared transaction 遗留占资源。

signals.desc: pg_stat_activity 中 state = 'idle in transaction' 的会话数异常多
最老事务的 xmin 长时间不推进，阻塞 VACUUM
应用日志中 ERROR: could not serialize access 频繁出现
pg_prepared_xacts 中有长时间未提交/回滚的 prepared transaction

conditions.desc: 超过 5 个会话处于 idle in transaction 状态
最老事务存活超过 30 分钟

skip_when.desc: 无活跃事务（数据库空闲）
skip_when.condition: pg_stat_activity 中无 active 或 idle in transaction 状态

skip_when.desc: 所有事务持续时间 < 1 分钟

root_causes.name: idle in transaction 会话累积
root_causes.desc: 应用开启事务后做了查询但忘记 COMMIT/ROLLBACK，或在等待外部响应期间保持事务打开。这些会话的 xmin 阻止 VACUUM 清理 dead tuples，导致表膨胀。

root_causes.name: 长事务阻塞 xmin horizon
root_causes.desc: 报表查询、数据迁移等长时间运行的事务（即使是只读 RR/Serializable）持有旧的 xmin snapshot，阻止系统回收该 xmin 之后产生的所有 dead tuples。

root_causes.name: Serializable 序列化失败
root_causes.desc: Serializable 隔离级别使用 SSI（可序列化快照隔离）检测读写冲突。当检测到无法序列化的并发模式时，PostgreSQL 会终止其中一个事务。应用必须实现重试逻辑。

root_causes.name: Prepared transaction 遗留
root_causes.desc: 两阶段提交的 PREPARE TRANSACTION 执行后，如果协调者宕机未完成 COMMIT/ROLLBACK PREPARED，事务会一直占用资源并阻塞 VACUUM。

step1_idle_in_transaction.desc: 查看 idle in transaction 会话的详情
step1_idle_in_transaction.sql: SELECT pid, usename, datname, state, now() - xact_start AS xact_duration, now() - state_change AS idle_duration, backend_xmin, backend_xid, LEFT(query, 120) AS last_query, application_name FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state IN ('idle in transaction', 'idle in transaction (aborted)') ORDER BY xact_start NULLS LAST

step2_long_transactions.desc: 查看所有长时间运行的事务
step2_long_transactions.sql: SELECT pid, usename, datname, state, now() - xact_start AS xact_duration, backend_xmin, LEFT(query, 120) AS query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE xact_start IS NOT NULL AND now() - xact_start > interval '5 minutes' ORDER BY xact_start

step3_xmin_horizon.desc: 查看当前 xmin horizon（所有活跃事务的最老 xmin）
step3_xmin_horizon.sql: SELECT min(backend_xmin) AS oldest_xmin, min(backend_xid) AS oldest_xid, now() - min(xact_start) AS oldest_xact_age FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE backend_xmin IS NOT NULL OR backend_xid IS NOT NULL

step4_prepared_transactions.sql: SELECT gid, prepared, owner, database, transaction AS xid FROM pg_prepared_xacts ORDER BY prepared

step5_isolation_levels.desc: 查看当前连接使用的隔离级别分布
step5_isolation_levels.sql: SELECT COALESCE(backend_type, 'unknown') AS type, count(*) FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY backend_type

step1_idle_count.desc: 统计 idle in transaction 会话数
step1_idle_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS idle_count, MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - xact_start))::int AS max_idle_sec FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state IN ('idle in transaction', 'idle in transaction (aborted)')

step2_long_xact_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS long_xact_count, MAX(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM now() - xact_start))::int AS max_xact_sec FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE xact_start IS NOT NULL AND now() - xact_start > interval '5 minutes'

step4_prepared_count.desc: 检查未提交的两阶段事务
step4_prepared_count.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS prepared_count, MIN(prepared) AS oldest_prepared FROM pg_prepared_xacts

real_world_examples.scenario: 连接池未配置自动回滚导致大量 idle in transaction
real_world_examples.symptoms: 200 个连接中 80 个 idle in transaction 超过 1 小时，VACUUM 无效，表膨胀 50%
real_world_examples.root_cause: PgBouncer transaction mode 下应用异常时未 ROLLBACK，连接归还后保持事务打开状态
real_world_examples.resolution: PgBouncer 配置 server_reset_query = 'DISCARD ALL' + idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = 10min
real_world_examples.result: idle in transaction 降至 0，VACUUM 恢复正常

real_world_examples.scenario: Prepared transaction 遗留 3 天阻塞 XID wraparound
real_world_examples.symptoms: age(datfrozenxid) 持续增长到 9 亿，autovacuum 无法冻结任何 XID
real_world_examples.root_cause: 分布式事务协调者宕机，PREPARE TRANSACTION 'xa_001' 遗留 3 天未提交/回滚
real_world_examples.resolution: ROLLBACK PREPARED 'xa_001' 后 VACUUM FREEZE 成功执行
real_world_examples.result: XID 年龄降至正常范围
